new_value: Verified and completed RFC 8613 encrypt+decrypt AAD path for lichen-oscore (now a re-export of the patched local oscore crate whose build_aad_cbor implements RFC 8613 Sec 5.4 Enc_structure). Added offline canonical-vector tests to rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs consuming test/vectors/oscore.json: test_request_unprotection_vectors (decrypt C.4-C.6 canonical ciphertexts via unprotect_request on receiver-role context), test_response_unprotection_vectors (decrypt C.7-C.8 via begin_unprotect_response+commit on client-role context), test_request_protection_with_id_context_vectors (encrypt coverage for C.6 which the existing loop skipped). Also fixed pre-existing clippy expect_fun_call in same file. cargo test -p lichen-oscore: 16 pass, 0 fail; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean.
